metadata.name: UpdateSpendRule
metadata.description: This API is used to update the Spend Rule on the Card.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: TransactionType
request_fields.description: The Spend Rules will be applied for this type of Transaction. Valid Values:1=Cash Access, 2=Online, 3=PIN POS Transaction, 4= Signature POS Transaction, 5=Contactless Transactions, 6= Recurring Transactions, 7= Card Not present Transactions Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: TransactionCategory
request_fields.description: This tag will define the transaction category Valid Values:1=All, 2=Domestic, 3=International, Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: TransactionAllowed
request_fields.description: This tag will define the transaction category Valid Values:0=No, 1=Yes Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: CardType
request_fields.description: This tag will define the Card Type Valid Values:1=Primary, 2=Seconday, 3=All Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: DefaultValueonCard
request_fields.description: Use this tag to provide the default value on card Valid Values:0=No, 1=Yes Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: SingleTransactionLimit
request_fields.description: Use this tag to provide the single transaction limit Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:100 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: DailySpendLimitCount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update daily spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:10 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: DailySpendLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update daily spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:500 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: WeeklySpendLimitCount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update Weekly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:10 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: WeeklySpendLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update weekly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:500 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: MonthlySpendLimitCount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update monthly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:10 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: MonthlySpendLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update monthly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:500 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: YearlySpendLimitCount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update yearly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:10 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: YearlySpendLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Use this tag to update yearly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:500 Condition:Any one of the limits is mandatory.

request_fields.name: Status
request_fields.description: Use this tag to provide the status of the Spend rule, whether it is Active or Inactive. Valid Values:1=Active, 2=Inactive Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: UpdateSpendRuleList
request_fields.description: UpdateSpendRuleList

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
